Fonts

Instrument Serif, Manrope and Noto Serif JP are served by Google Fonts under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

Images

Photography from Pexels and Unsplash, free for commercial use. Images are placeholders and not sold as part of this template.

Icons

All icons and the Hanabi mark are original to this template and may be used in any project built with it.

Content

Hanabi, its team, reviews and menu are fictional and for demonstration only.
